title: How to close the confidence gap: Better support for small businesses
description: In conversation with Tara Askham, Grace Hardy, and Stuart Miller 36% of UK small businesses don't know if they were profitable last month, 51% struggle with cash flow, while 35% of 18–34 year olds say they lack the financial skills to manage their business. This session explores how accountants can close the confidence gap through clearer communication and better financial conversations. Attendees will leave with practical ideas to strengthen advisory capability, embed financial confidence across their organisation, and create meaningful impact for the small businesses they support.

title: How to be tax-efficient when extracting company profits
categories: Tax / VAT / MTD, Tax & MTD, Payroll
description: In this session we will consider: Whether the employers' NIC employment allowance can cover Director salary NIC costs The impact of the increased income tax rate on dividends Different corporation tax rates Different income tax rates and possible other income Varying shareholding percentages Anti-avoidance rules including the settlements legislation Additional disclosures required for dividends New rates of loans to participators Pension savings becoming part of the IHT estate The workshop will allow time for worked examples and Q&A and is aimed at those who advise small to medium sized company owners and directors.

title: How to design, package and sell a fully outsourced finance function
categories: Sales & Marketing / Branding / Social Media, Data & Analytics, Outsourcing, Marketing & Growth
description: Many accountancy firms want to move up the value chain by offering outsourced finance and advisory services, but the biggest challenge isn't ambition - it's execution. In this interactive masterclass, Kayleigh Graham will explore how firms can design, package and sell fully outsourced finance services that create real revenue and better client outcomes. Drawing on her experience supporting hundreds of accounting firms to launch new services, she will share practical insights on structuring offers, building a repeatable sales process, and turning growth plans into real, deliverable services.

title: How to deliver five star service in a digital practice: Client care that scales
categories: Client Relationships / Customer Service, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, CRM & Comms, Data & Analytics
description: Clients don't judge you on tax jargon; they remember how simple, timely and personal you make things feel. In this fast‑paced session I'll share a practical framework for five‑star client care in a modern accountancy practice, balancing automation and AI with a distinctly human touch. Drawing on network‑wide examples with clients, expect usable wins: service standards, proactive client touchpoints, smart portals, complaint‑to‑champion recovery, and the metrics that drive loyalty and referrals.

title: How to decide whether to incorporate a business or landlord
description: In this session, we will compare the tax and legal position of operating a trade or property business in an individual's own name versus a corporate vehicle. This will consider: - Varying tax rates - Starting a new venture compared to transferring an existing one - CGT and SDLT traps - Anti-avoidance legislation and recent HMRC Spotlights - Where Family Investment Companies play their part - Legal protection - Other commercial considerations The workshop will allow plenty of time for worked examples and Q&A. This session is aimed at those who advise self-employed individuals and property owners.

title: How to get clients to respect you
description: Do you have clients who don't follow your process, don't stick to deadlines, don't read emails… then expect miracles at the last minute? If so, this session is for you. Tim English (founder of The Accountants' Table) shares straight talking lessons from building and exiting a firm, plus what he sees weekly working with UK accountants. You'll leave with a clear framework and practical examples you can use immediately to win back respect and reduce stress across your firm. Respect isn't about being liked; it's expectations, boundaries and training clients how to treat you and your team.

title: How to create a workplace that saves lives: The business case for supporting survivors
description: A safe workplace is business critical. Domestic abuse affects performance, absence, turnover, financial risk and the safety of staff and clients. Cheryl shares the human and commercial case for why every finance team must support survivors. Learn to spot signs in office and remote settings, why they are missed, and how to respond in trauma informed ways, including what to say and what not to say. Take away clear next steps: a practical policy, signposting to specialist support, and simple actions you can embed into HR, wellbeing and risk.

speakers.name: Cheryl Sharp
speakers.job_title: CEO | Domestic Abuse at Work Specialist | Survivor Mentor
speakers.company: Pink Pig Financials Ltd & Elpis Kai Eleutheria Ltd

title: Leading through uncertainty: Economic insight and strategic action for finance leaders
description: In today's volatile economy, the decisions of CFOs and FDs have a direct impact on organisational resilience and growth. Join this session to hear Jonathan Ashworth, Chief Economist, ACCA deliver a concise, data-driven analysis of the current economic outlook, covering key trends, market risks, and opportunities that will influence strategic decisions. A panel of CFOs, will then share how they are responding in real time, exploring how finance leaders can drive proactive decision-making, optimise performance, and safeguard long-term value. The session will also highlight how accountants in practice can support smaller businesses, offering practical guidance to help clients navigate uncertainty with confidence. Packed with insight, peer-led perspectives, and actionable takeaways, this session equips finance leaders to anticipate challenges, make smarter decisions, and lead their organisations with impact. Global Economic Conditions Survey: Q4 2025 | ACCA Global

title: The Future of Finance is Human: Human-Led, AI-Enabled
description: The future finance function will be human-led and AI-enabled — guiding businesses and governing intelligent systems. As AI becomes embedded across enterprises, finance leaders must strengthen Business Guidance—supporting strategic decision-making and enterprise value creation—while enabling Business Governance, ensuring the integrity, accountability, and transparency of AI-enabled decision systems. This keynote explores how these two pillars evolve in the AI-enabled enterprise and the capability shifts finance professionals must make to remain effective and relevant in the future.

title: Three years on: Lessons from Comic Relief's digital transformation
description: Implementing a new finance system is a major milestone, but the real impact takes time. Three years after go-live, Comic Relief shares how digital transformation improved efficiency, reporting, and decision-making. This session offers practical tips to sustain benefits, avoid pitfalls, and drive long-term value. Plus, honest lessons on what worked, what didn't, and strategies to maximise technology investments. Learning Outcomes • Apply insights with practical strategies • Understand digital transformation impact • Recognise value of digital transformation • Sustain growth and strategic decision-making

title: Deepfakes, data breaches and delusions: The AI risks you need to know about
categories: AI, AI & Automation, Cyber Security, Practice Management
description: How easy is it to swindle an FD out of their company's money? Jake Moore did it with a bit of research and an AI voice generator. AI has given scammers powerful tools for fooling the unwary accountant or finance team. Add to that the danger of exposing confidential data – plus AI's ability to make things up – and you have a new area of risk to contend with. Jake, Global Cybersecurity Advisor at ESET and a former police digital forensics expert, joins Olivia McMillan, COO of cloud accounting provider iplicit, to help you learn about AI risks before the hackers beat you to it. You may never trust a voice memo again.

title: Beyond the numbers: FDs shaping strategic business direction
description: A panel discussion covering the role of the FD in supporting, challenging and shaping the strategic direction of their organisation. Using data, metrics and a wider world view, helping organisations make the most effective strategic steps for resilience and growth.

speakers.name: Nevil Tynemouth
speakers.job_title: Executive Coach, Author, Facilitator and International Speaker

title: E-invoicing is coming: How finance teams can prepare now
categories: E Invoicing, Data & Analytics, Banking & Payments, Practice Management
description: E-invoicing is expected in the UK by 2029, and the shift towards real-time digital reporting is accelerating globally. For finance teams, this is more than a compliance update — it will fundamentally reshape invoicing processes, ERP integration, reporting and internal controls. This session examines why governments are driving adoption, the operational and cash flow implications for organisations, lessons from international markets, and the practical steps finance leaders can take now to assess readiness, engage stakeholders, and plan a controlled, cost-effective transition.

title: Impress the board: What any top CFO or finance leader needs to know
categories: How To Influence Up / How To Sell Yourself
description: Modern boards expect more than accurate numbers; they want finance leaders who communicate with clarity, challenge constructively, and steer strategic decisions. In this interactive panel, Suezann Holmes interviews 2–3 experienced NEDs to reveal what really stands out in board packs, reports, and live discussions. You will learn how to translate complex financials into board-ready narratives, avoid common engagement pitfalls, and use data-driven storytelling to build credibility, influence outcomes, and strengthen long-term board relationships as a modern finance leader.

title: From back office to brand asset: Why payment behaviour is now a CFO's reputation play
categories: Regulation & Legislation, Banking & Payments, Marketing & Growth
description: As the UK introduces the toughest late-payment rules in the G7, how companies pay their suppliers is becoming a public measure of trust and credibility. In this session, Terry Corby, Founder of Good Business Pays, explains how payment behaviour has moved from a back-office process to a board-level reputational issue — and how Finance Directors can use it to attract better suppliers, strengthen customer confidence, reduce risk and turn compliance into a competitive advantage.

title: The UK economy is stalling: How accountants can help our clients save it
description: The UK economy has stalled. Clients are being squeezed by the cost of living crisis, rising wages and higher taxes and are facing tougher challenges than during Covid. So what can accountants do now? Will Farnell explores how better client conversations create clarity - not just for the business, but for the ambitions of the business owner. Joined by Richard Bertin (All In Place), sharing practical steps to tackle today's economic pressures and maximise your impact at Accountex.

categories: Advisory, AI & Automation, Data & Analytics, Practice Management
description: Artificial intelligence is no longer a future concept in accounting - it is reshaping how work is delivered, priced and valued. From automated bookkeeping to smarter reporting and faster communication, AI is changing day-to-day practice. This session cuts through the hype to show where AI delivers real value today. Using practical examples, it explores time savings, accuracy gains and workflow shifts and what this means for pricing and advisory. It also covers governance, risk and data security, helping firms adopt AI responsibly and profitably.

categories: Market Overview & Insight, AI & Automation, Payroll, HR & People
description: The world of work is transforming fast. AI and automation are reshaping roles, while SMEs face mounting pressure around hiring, retention and rising people costs. For accounting firms, this isn't just an HR issue - it's a strategic advisory opportunity. In this thought-leadership session, App Advisory Plus and Employment Hero explore the workforce trends shaping 2026 and what they mean for profitability and resilience. Discover how firms can help clients reset processes, rethink workforce design and move beyond payroll compliance into strategic workforce advisory.

categories: AI, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, Practice Management
description: AI is moving faster than most firms can keep up - but you don't need to be an expert to harness it. This energising session guides you from exploration to integration using a practical three-phase framework: individual experimentation, team adoption and operational embedding. Discover how to automate emails, meeting notes, variance analysis and SOPs while building confidence across your firm. Packed with real examples and ready-to-use ideas, you'll leave with clear next steps to save time, elevate advisory and embed AI without overwhelm.

description: In this session, Kelly Goss demystifies AI agents and shows how to use Zapier to build practical, business-ready automations across finance, operations and client services. You'll learn the basics of Zapier, what AI agents really are (and aren't), and where they add value beyond simple workflows. Through real accounting and advisory use cases — from client onboarding to internal knowledge agents — discover how to move from idea to implementation without coding or replacing your tech stack.

title: The future-ready firm: Building an advisory-led practice that attracts better clients, better talent, and better margins
description: The accounting profession is evolving fast, and the firms thriving today are those embracing an advisory-led model built on purpose, people, and technology. Will and Richard will explore how forward-thinking firms are reshaping their practices. They'll discuss why advisory is becoming essential, how purpose-driven firms attract better clients and talent, and how aligning people, process, and technology helps deliver scalable, high-value services. Discover what successful firms are doing today to future-proof their business and deliver extreme value.

description: With a combined 40 years' experience building innovation-led accounting firms, Will and Lucy have seen it all. In this candid fireside chat, they share the highs, lows and hard-earned lessons from two decades of tech evolution and people leadership. Reflecting on what's changed - and what lies ahead - this session promises honest insight, practical learning and plenty of real-world perspective.

title: The firm of 2030: What needs to change now
categories: Market Overview & Insight, AI & Automation, Data & Analytics, HR & People, Practice Management
description: The accounting firm of 2030 will look very different. AI, advisory evolution, new pricing models, talent shortages and rising client expectations are reshaping the profession. This forward-looking session gives firm leaders practical insight into the changes they must embrace now to stay relevant, profitable and competitive. As day one draws to a close, join us for a drink and a lively, interactive discussion on the strategic decisions and priorities needed to build a future-ready, resilient firm.

title: How to build an AI-native accounting Firm
categories: AI, AI & Automation, CRM & Comms, Practice Management
description: AI-native firms are being built differently from the ground up. In this session, Briefcase founder Reuben Steenkamp and Flexal founder Rob Collings share what it really looks like to design an AI-first accounting business while keeping client experience at the centre. They'll cover three levels of adoption: firms who've never really used AI, firms who are dabbling but unsure what to do next, and firms with in-house developers. You'll leave with practical ideas for where you are on that spectrum, plus a concrete AI workflow you can try in your firm the very next day.

title: Before you buy AI: The questions every accountant should ask their software supplier
description: AI is transforming accounting software, but not all solutions deliver real value. In this session, Ben Bishop guides accountants through the essential questions to ask before adopting AI, including data security, transparency, ethics, testing, reliability, and whether the vendor truly understands the accounting industry, its workflows, and regulatory requirements. Discover how to cut through the hype, protect client trust, evaluate functionality, ensure compliance, and make certain any AI tool delivers measurable, practical, and sustainable benefits safely and effectively for your practice.

title: What happens to the value of relationships when your client is AI?
categories: AI, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, Practice Management
description: As artificial intelligence takes on an increasingly active role in business operations, a provocative new question is emerging for accounting professionals: when your client is no longer a person but an AI system, what becomes of the relationship that has always sat at the heart of great client service? This session explores how the rise of AI-driven businesses and autonomous systems is challenging traditional notions of trust, communication, and value in the client-adviser dynamic. We'll examine whether the skills that have long defined exceptional accountants - empathy, judgement, and the ability to build lasting human connections - remain relevant in a world where decisions are increasingly made by algorithms, and what new forms of value professionals must cultivate to stay indispensable in an AI-first economy.

title: AI in practice: what's working, what's not, and what to prioritise
description: AI is firmly on the agenda for accountancy practices, but separating meaningful impact from hype remains a challenge. This session explores where AI is already delivering measurable value — improving efficiency, enhancing client service and supporting advisory growth — and where adoption is proving slower or less commercially viable. Delegates will gain a practical framework to assess opportunities, manage risk responsibly and prioritise AI investment based on strategic value rather than noise.

speakers.name: Linsey Tait
speakers.job_title: Tax Technology Director, Tax Technical & Support - Grant Thornton UK LLP

title: Is AI recommending your business?
description: Your next client won't Google you, they'll ask ChatGPT. And unless you're feeding the right signals into the algorithm, you won't even be considered. Over 77% of ChatGPT users already use it instead of search engines. It's not showing ads. It's not showing who's shouting the loudest. It's showing who looks the most credible online. What you'll learn: 1) How AI search actually works (without the jargon) 2) Which trust signals matter and how to improve them 3) Why your competitors are being recommended and you're not Because if AI can't find you, your next client won't either.

title: From automation to AI: How we built a digitally scalable advisory firm
categories: AI, AI & Automation, Data & Analytics, Practice Management
description: This session shares how Roesgaard has implemented integrations, automation, RPA, app-based workflows and generative AI to transform daily operations and client delivery. Attendees will gain practical insight into how APIs, AI tools and supplier collaborations can eliminate manual work, improve quality and free up time for advisory services. The session focuses on real-world implementation, governance and the business impact of modern technology in an accounting firm.

title: When time saved isn't money made: Rethinking value in the age of AI
description: AI promises to make accountants faster, smarter and more efficient, but what happens when efficiency eats into your revenue model? This session dives into the uncomfortable but essential truth: saving time doesn't automatically mean making more money. Join a panel of forward-thinking firms and technology leaders as they unpack what AI really means for pricing, profitability and client value. From mid-market practices to VC-backed firms with diverse tech stacks, we'll explore how to reprice, reposition and rethink the way firms capture value in a world where AI is quietly rewriting the economics of accounting.

title: The zombie office: The darker side to AI
description: AI isn't coming for your job, it's coming to eat your brains. Have you ever considered how AI is rewiring our lives? What happens when we stunt creativity and rely on machinary to do our jobs? Is AI an efficiency hack, or are we unleashing a beast? This session aims to highlight the darker side of AI, exploring it's effect on our planet, it's unconscious bias and exasperating effect on the human race. We want to promote mindful, restricted use of AI, and re-ignite creativity among the audience.

title: The conversation no one is having about staffing
categories: Engagement / Recruitment / Training / Development / Upskilling / Retention / HR, HR & People
description: This session will be an honest conversation about the realities of recruiting and retaining staff, and the challenges of trying to build and maintain culture. Every business owner says staffing is their biggest challenge, but it's not always something people can talk openly about - especially online. With some amazing successes with her team, as well as some absolute horror stories Hannah will share her experiences and advice with the audience on all aspects of having a team, including the messy bits. It won't be a "how to," but she will share what has and hasn't worked for her, in a light-hearted but honest way.

title: Accountancy unlocked: The trends transforming the profession in 2026
description: The last 12 months have reshaped the accountancy landscape—rapid digitalisation, new regulatory and funding pressures, evolving learner expectations. Join sector specialists as they unpack the biggest changes already impacting practices and employers, and explore what's coming next.

title: Policy, pathways and professional progress: What's changing in 2026?
categories: Engagement / Recruitment / Training / Development / Upskilling / Retention / HR, HR & People
description: With new qualification structures, evolving professional standards and policy changes hitting the sector, staying informed has never mattered more. Hear directly from the leading accountancy bodies as they break down what's changing and why—and what these developments mean for students, employers and providers. If you want to understand how regulatory updates will shape training, recruitment and progression, this is the session you can't afford to miss.

title: The true state of talent: Salary benchmarks & employee expectations revealed
categories: Engagement / Recruitment / Training / Development / Upskilling / Retention / HR, Tax & MTD, Data & Analytics, HR & People
description: Join us for an economic update from Louise Hellem, Chief Economist at the CBI, as she shares the latest insights on how shifting economic conditions are reshaping the labour market. From evolving workforce trends to key changes in talent management , Louise will set the scene for what accounting employers need to know right now. How much should you really be paying? What benefits matter most to today's accounting talent? And how do you compare to industry benchmarks? This data-driven session lifts the lid on the latest salary insights and employee benefits trends across the profession. With expert commentary from recruitment and employer partners, you'll discover what motivates staff, what improves retention, and where your organisation can stand out as an employer of choice.

title: Why people stay — and why they leave: The employee experience
categories: Engagement / Recruitment / Training / Development / Upskilling / Retention / HR, Data & Analytics, HR & People, Marketing & Growth
description: Attracting and retaining top accountancy talent is tougher than ever. Drawing on Welliba's latest data insights, this session explores what really drives employee experience in the sector — from wellbeing and flexibility to culture, progression and the red flags that push people away. Perfect for firms that want to boost retention, strengthen employer brand and understand what the workforce really values in 2026.

title: Future-ready finance: Harnessing multigenerational strengths for better collaboration
categories: Education & Qualifications, Data & Analytics, HR & People
description: In today's finance sector, up to five generations are working side by side — each bringing different communication styles, expectations, and strengths. This panel brings together industry leaders to explore how finance teams can bridge generational differences, foster inclusive cultures, and create environments where everyone can thrive. Expect practical insights, real-world examples, and strategies you can apply immediately to improve collaboration and team performance.

speakers.name: Becky Glover
speakers.job_title: CFO of Mazuma & Co-Founder of Connexion Career Collective

title: The 5-year future: Where are accountancy bodies taking the profession?
categories: Education & Qualifications, AI & Automation, Data & Analytics
description: What will the accountancy sector look like in five years? Hear visionary insights directly from the UK's major professional bodies as they explore megatrends, technological disruption, regulatory reform and global forces shaping the profession. From AI readiness to sustainability reporting to the evolving role of the accountant.

title: Future talent: Why different people will be tomorrow's leaders
categories: Diversity, Equality & Inclusion, AI & Automation, HR & People
description: The accountancy world is changing fast. The future of leadership is in question. AI is taking many entry-level roles, and young people are looking at, traditional models of employment and not seeing a world they want to be part of. Many are choosing self-employment or starting their own businesses. What does this mean for the future? The next generation of leaders will be different. This panel discussion will look at this topic from different angles. We will discuss: Gender diversity Racial diversity Neuro-diversity Socio-economic diversity Age diversity We will discuss practical ideas for leaders to think about now.

title: Tax practice compliance: Including agent registration
description: Tax practitioners have to deal with a range of compliance issues. The focus has been on the AML regulations and the requirements of PCRT but The Finance Bill 2025-26 introduces new requirements that require preparation. This session will refresh delegates on key AML and ethical requirements for tax work, and cover the new requirements in 2026 for tax agents to register with HMRC and meet minimum standards. We will provide an overview of the new strict liability criminal offence for failure to disclose tax avoidance schemes and consider the new lower bar for investigating tax advisers and applying sanctions.

title: Grow your practice with tax consultancy
categories: Scaling / Practice Growth, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, Marketing & Growth
description: With standard accountancy, bookkeeping, and tax return work becoming increasingly price competitive, how well equipped is your practice to deliver tax consultancy work? This session explores the landscape of tax consultancy work including the draft Tax Adviser legislation, the current hot topics of tax consultancy, and the impact of AI on tax consultancy. His talk includes some game changing tips based on his experience of pricing and selling tax consultancy over a 30+ year career. He'll also pass on fee negotiation skills and how to gain a competitive advantage over other firms. Get ready to grow your practice!

speakers.name: James Butterworth
speakers.job_title: Tax Expert and VIP Commercial Manager

title: How to navigate the new income tax penalty regime
categories: Tax / VAT / MTD, Tax & MTD, Banking & Payments, Document Management
description: Are you up to speed with the new penalty regimes coming to income tax? The introduction of Making Tax Digital (MTD) brings with it a new penalty regime for late filing and late payment. But that's not all - at the Budget it was announced that these new penalties will apply to all self-assessment taxpayers (whether in MTD or not) from April 2027. Now is therefore the time to get your head round the rules. In this practically focused session we'll use examples to show how the new rules will work in practice, and provide you with some top tips to help your clients avoid a penalty.

title: Are you bored of MTD yet? The reality of MTD IT in practice
description: A practical look at where the profession really is with MTDfIT We'll explore the stress points that are draining time and energy, the power points where firms are seeing genuine efficiency gains, and—most importantly—how we can breathe life back into the process rather than simply endure it. Now that MTD is live from April 2026, this session focuses on what's actually happening in firms today, what's being overlooked & what's working. Attendees will: Understand the key stress points firms are experiencing with MTD IT Learn practical ways to cope Gain clarity on what to focus on next instead of trying to do it all

title: We need to talk about the un-represented
description: From April, an estimated 212,000 taxpayers who currently have no professional support will fall within the scope of MTD. That number will only increase as thresholds continue to decrease in the coming years. Our expert panel will explore: • Will accountants and bookkeepers face a surge of last minute enquiries? • Could this create disruption during an already high pressure period, or does it present a strategic opportunity for firms? • What practical steps can practices take now to prepare and stay ahead?

title: Tax adviser regulation
description: This talk covers the new provisions set out in the Finance bill 2025-26 requiring registration with HMRC in order to interact with them in relation to a client's tax affairs. He'll look at: Advisers who are excepted from the requirements The 3 registration conditions When HMRC may suspend an adviser's registration Financial penalties and when they can apply Rights of appeal HMRC right of publication of tax adviser information following penalty or notice of ineligibility

title: MTD for income tax, compliance and the AI-enhanced accountant and bookkeeper: The new normal
categories: AI, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, Practice Management
description: As MTD for Income Tax advances, HMRC's priority is better data, fewer errors, and closing the tax gap - enabled by technology. This session explores how AI, automation, and AI agents can support compliant MTD IT workflows by improving data accuracy and flagging errors early, while keeping the accountant and bookkeeper firmly in control. Bringing together HMRC, tax experts, and practitioners, the session connects HMRC's digital roadmap with real-world firm experience and the practical steps firms can take now to prepare for the next phase of MTD IT.

speakers.name: Paul Lodder
speakers.job_title: VP: Product Strategy and Accounting expertise

title: MTD for landlords: Turning a compliance burden into a scalable advisory opportunity
description: MTD for landlords doesn't have to mean more work for less reward. This session explores how firms can use MTD to strengthen landlord relationships, create recurring revenue, and move from annual compliance to ongoing advisory. Attendees will learn how real-time property data enables better tax planning, clearer pricing, and more valuable conversations with landlord clients.

title: What's next for finance? How today's CFO mindset is reshaping tomorrow's decisions
categories: Market Trends, AI & Automation, Data & Analytics, HR & People
description: As finance leadership broadens beyond traditional accounting roles, CFOs and Finance Directors face new pressures shaped by industry complexity, technology choices, and rising expectations. Drawing on the findings from AccountsIQ's annual CFO Mindset Report, this session unveils exclusive insight into how finance leaders across different sectors feel about key challenges such as under-used or over-complex software, automation, AI and decision-making confidence. Moving beyond a single-year narrative, it explores where finance leadership is heading next — and how systems, processes and skillsets must evolve

title: AI-Ready Finance: From Global Compliance to Intelligent Operations
categories: AI & Automation, Data & Analytics, Banking & Payments, Practice Management
description: As governments accelerate the shift to digital finance—through e-invoicing, real-time reporting, and automated compliance - forward-looking CFOs are moving beyond compliance to build intelligent, insight-driven finance functions. Explore how global regulatory change is reshaping finance, why most AI investments fall short, and what it truly means to be AI-ready. In this session, two perspectives come together to tell one story. We'll examine how global regulatory shifts are reshaping the finance function from the outside in — and why the race to buy AI tools is solving the wrong problem.

speakers.name: Cynthia Rajan Babu
speakers.job_title: Head of Marketing - Zoho Books & Zoho Practice

title: Baby Boomers: Growth through acquisition, opportunity and threat
description: The UK is approaching a major exit crunch. Baby Boomers own 37% of UK businesses, rising to 66% when including owners aged 50+, many of whom will seek to exit at the same time. For CFOs, the risk is clear: without early value creation, most businesses will fail to attract buyers and face costly solvent liquidation. As organic growth is unlikely to deliver £1m+ EBITDA and an attractive multiplier, this session explores how CFO and Accountants should take the lead to help owners execute a successful buy‑and‑build strategy to build value and enjoy a successful exit in a buyer's market.

title: How to sell fractional CFO services: The exact process behind a 7-figure practice
categories: Fractional CFO - Training / Systems / Advice, CRM & Comms, Outsourcing, Marketing & Growth, Practice Management
description: Fractional finance is booming, but most new FDs struggle with one thing: selling. Elliott breaks down the precise sales process behind scaling a fractional CFO business to a seven-figure valuation, a full pipeline, and the ability to turn clients away. Using SPICED, a free CRM setup, and a step-by-step workflow, he shows how finance leaders can run stronger discovery calls and follow-ups. Attendees will also see real examples of messaging, deal tracking, and next-day actions they can implement immediately to start winning fractional work.

title: Are you comparing the right things? Benchmarking that actually helps
description: Most finance teams track something, whether that is budget versus actuals, month over month results, or industry averages. But which comparisons actually lead to better decisions? Our Panel of working CFO's and accountants explain how they rebuilt their benchmarking approach, including what they stopped tracking, what they began focusing on, and the surprising metrics that ultimately changed how they run the business.

speakers.name: Frances Kay
speakers.job_title: Co-Founder App Advisory Plus and Partner of TC Group (Farnell Clarke)
speakers.company: App Advisory Plus / TC Group (Farnell Clarke)

title: Can CFOs really become CEOs?
description: Are finance professionals simply the guardians of numbers — or are they the next generation of visionary CEOs? This thought-provoking talk challenges one of the most persistent assumptions in corporate leadership: that finance leaders are too risk-averse, too analytical, or too internally focused to lead an entire organisation. Exploring the evolving role of the CFO and other finance professionals, the session examines whether financial discipline is a limitation — or a hidden superpower in today's volatile, data-driven business world.

title: Building a digital personal brand as a finance leader
description: This session will cover how to build an online professional presence as a finance leader in 2026. It will cover how to establish your thought leader credentials, without straying into clickbait and shallow 'influencer' tactics. The impact of this will be to build presence for finance leaders, ultimately boosting careers and generating leads & sales for in-house finance leaders

title: Beyond the Branch: how fractional CFOs, accountants and banks can work together to support established SMEs
categories: Banking Services, Open Banking, Payment / FX, Data & Analytics, Banking & Payments, Outsourcing
description: With banking access becoming harder for established SMEs, accountants and fractional CFOs are stepping in to fill the gap. Join Allica Bank's Sophie Hossack (Head of Partnerships) and Conrad Ford (Chief Strategy Officer) to explore how advisors can work together with banks to guide clients through borrowing, cash flow and financial planning. They will share practical strategies for forecasting liquidity, managing repayment pressures, and accessing tailored banking solutions. Discover how collaborative approaches can protect working capital and help businesses stay resilient in the current market.

title: How accountancy firms can play a significant role in protecting the UK's SME community
description: Accountancy firms are particularly attractive to criminals due to the sheer density of valuable data; therefore, they play a unique role in securing not just client data but also helping their ecosystem of client businesses understand their role in achieving cyber resilience. Richard will outline the work of the CRC Network and the benefits of this police-led, business-focused initiative. He will not only outline how accountancy firms can take advantage of a range of fully-funded cyber services, but also how we can support them to encourage their client businesses to become more cyber resilient.

title: The Numbers You Can't See: Why Most Firms Are Flying Blind on Capacity and Margin
description: Most firms know their fee income to the penny but can't answer five basic questions about how that income is actually earned. What's your recovery rate by service line? How much WIP is sitting over 90 days? Where is senior partner time really going? This session exposes the gap between what firms know about their clients' businesses and what they know about their own — and why that gap is where margin quietly disappears. You'll leave with a practical self-diagnostic you can run on Monday morning, and a framework for turning time from an admin task into the commercial input that drives your firm's profitability.

title: Embedded finance for accounting platforms: Unifying systems, simplifying SME spend
categories: Technology & Software, Expenses, Banking & Payments, Practice Management
description: In this session, Kunal Galav, VP of Pleo Embedded and a senior leader from Mastercard will share how accounting platforms can deliver added value to their SME clients through embedded finance. The panel will explore how integrating spend management directly into accounting platforms reduces manual work, provides real-time visibility, and strengthens the advisory relationship with SMEs. Drawing on the Pleo Embedded experience, Kunal will highlight how seamless, partner-delivered finance solutions drive efficiency, accuracy, and greater customer satisfaction.

title: Innovation that actually works: Rebuilding engagements from the ground up
categories: AI, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, Practice Management
description: Many firms have invested in new technology and AI but some see limited value. This session explores the engagement model, the practical blueprint for how work is planned, performed, reviewed and delivered and explains why it must come first. Attendees will learn how rethinking engagement design improves efficiency, consistency and audit quality, where outdated workflows quietly create friction, and how AI delivers real value only when applied at the right stage of the engagement lifecycle. The session also outlines where firms can begin making changes without disrupting existing standards or teams.

speakers.name: Danielle Cheek
speakers.job_title: Senior Vice President, AI, Analytics and Assurance

title: How to increase revenue WITHOUT new clients
description: Many accounting firms leave significant revenue on the table by viewing tax work purely as compliance rather than strategic advisory. The key to unlocking new revenue without acquiring new clients lies in deepening relationships through proactive tax advisory services. Create recurring revenue by offering quarterly tax strategy reviews, estimated tax planning, entity structuring, high-net-worth planning etc. You're already trusted by these clients and understand their finances, you're simply expanding how you serve them.

title: Scope creep, transaction counts, and getting paid fairly in modern practices
description: Scope creep and shifting client complexity make it increasingly difficult for bookkeeping and accountancy practices to price services accurately. In this session, experienced practitioners explore the challenges of tracking changing transaction volumes and client needs across a growing client base. Drawing on real-world practice insights, the speakers discuss how better use of technology and data can improve visibility, support timely repricing, and ensure firms are fairly paid for the work they deliver.

title: Payroll tax year update
description: Join Mathew Akrigg, Policy and Research Officer from the CIPP, who will guide you through a payroll legislation update as we're at the start of the new tax year. We will focus of the changes to Statutory Sick Pay, so don't miss this essential update to ensure you and your clients remain compliant with their most important process - paying their workforce!

speakers.name: Mathew Akrigg
speakers.company: The Chartered Institute of Payroll Professionals (CIPP)

title: Increasing prices without losing any client satisfaction
description: This session will show you accountants how to: - Increase client fees significantly without disruptive fee shocks - Reduce pressure in your practice while improving profitability - Run sales conversations that consistently secure higher fees - Know with confidence whether your pricing is too low, too high, or exactly right

title: Practising certificates: Why they matter and how to get it right
description: This discussion explains the importance of holding an ACCA practice certificate in the accounting profession and outline the benefits and responsibilities that come with it. Covering: Why a Practice Certificate Matters • Legal and regulatory requirements. • Professional credibility and client trust. • Access to certain services (audit, regulated activities). • Protection against liability and disciplinary action. • The Dos and Don'ts - how to stay compliant

title: Beyond compliance: Taking AML one step further, an in-depth guide for accounting practices
categories: AML - Anti Money Laundering, Tax & MTD, AML/KYC
description: In this session our panel will discuss AML regulations and the support and resources ACCA have available. The panel will discuss why AML matters: legal obligations, reputational risk, and penalties (e.g., HMRC fines, criminal liability).

title: Beyond numbers: How accountants lead the sustainability agenda
description: In this session we will hear from our panel of experts on how and why sustainability is reshaping accounting practices and why accountants are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. We will hear: • Why sustainability matters for businesses and stakeholders. • What the role of the accountant is in relation to sustainability and why it is so important • What are the challenges and how we can work through them • Practical actions and next steps for driving sustainability in practice forward

title: From practitioner to practice owner: Making the leap with confidence
description: Hear from practice owners Jonny Stead and Ifat Jhugroo and how they navigated the opportunity of becoming practitioners to owning their practice. In this session we'll cover: • Why Consider Ownership? • Benefits and risks • Understand the right opportunity • How to prepare i.e. building financial readiness (funding options, personal credit). • Legal and compliance essentials. • Potential challenges and how to manage them

title: AI in practice
categories: Technology & Software, AI, AI & Automation, Practice Management
description: In this session our panellists share real-world examples and use cases of how accounting firms are successfully leveraging AI to drive productivity gains, efficiency, and capacity in their back-office operations and administrative workflows. We will discuss strategies for evaluating and selecting the right AI tools and platforms for accounting practices, considering factors like integration, security, and ease of use. We'll explore the implications of AI on the future of accounting education and training, and how firms can ensure their teams maintain the necessary skills and judgment as AI automates certain tasks.

speakers.name: Paul Lodder
speakers.job_title: VP: Product Strategy and Accounting expertise

title: Cyber threats & future-proofing firms
description: In this session hear from ACCA's Head of Risk Management and Corporate Governance and panellists on the next wave of cyber risk and what SMPs should do today to be prepared. A future focused session that discusses why emerging technology poses real risks to today's cybersecurity and operational resilience. We unpack how AI- and quantum-driven attacks could compromise encrypted client data, digital signatures, and the systems firms rely on — and outline the practical steps practices can take now to stay resilient.

speakers.name: Rachael Johnson
speakers.job_title: Global Head of Risk Management and Corporate Governance for Policy and Insights

title: Career paths reimagined – what's driving change and what skills accountants need for the future
categories: Engagement / Recruitment / Training / Development / Upskilling / Retention / HR, AI & Automation
description: A forward-looking session on what human skills matter most in an AI-first accounting firm. Explore how technology is reshaping the accounting profession. Identify the critical skills accountants must develop by 2026. Highlight future trends and how to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving landscape.

title: From practice to portfolio: Expanding your skillset for advisory and board roles
description: Hear from our panel as we explore the options on diversifying skill sets outside of the day to day work of practitioners. The panel will share their experience on how you explore there these opportunities and what they did to transition to these roles. Our panellists bring a broad range of experience and expertise, from holding NED and advisory roles. The panellists collective experience and expertise provide insight on how to successfully transition to non-executive directorship roles.

title: The new accounting era: How to lead in the age of complexity and AI
categories: AI, AI & Automation, Data & Analytics, HR & People
description: Unprecedented change is reshaping the profession. Legislation, AI and talent shortages are all colliding. The pressure is real, and it's accelerating. Sage CFO Jacqui Cartin shares her view of what this means for finance professionals. She explores how the profession is evolving, and why this is a moment for leadership. Lisa Ewens, SVP Product, shows how combining AI with human support can remove the busywork to amplify your expertise. You'll leave with practical insights and ways to confidently navigate through this changing landscape.

title: MTD for Income Tax: the start line and the road ahead
categories: Tax / VAT / MTD, Tax & MTD, CRM & Comms, Data & Analytics
description: MTD for Income Tax is here - but just one month in, most firms are still very much at the starting line, gearing up for their first quarterly submissions. In this session we'll look at experiences so far, including: - what's working smoothly - where firms are starting to encounter challenges - how accountants and bookkeepers are adapting their processes and client communications You'll leave with practical, realistic insights into what your practice can take forward - and guidance on how to prepare for what comes next as MTD continues to evolve.

title: I let AI do every role in my accountancy practice. I don't recommend it
description: AI is advancing fast in accountancy, but it's not always clear where it genuinely helps — and where it creates problems. So Alexis decided to go too far on purpose, letting AI do every role in an accountancy practice to stress-test how it behaves in the real world of complex work, multiple teams, and client expectations. Through funny failures and surprising successes, Alexis explores what this revealed about where AI shines, where it struggles, and why leaders often find change hard to embed — from fear of failure and unclear outcomes to change fatigue and benefits that never quite spread across the firm.

title: From data to decisions: How you turn tools into impact and value
categories: Technology & Software, AI & Automation, HR & People
description: There's a lot of talk about AI and regulation lately, but what matters most is what genuinely helps you and your clients move forward. This session explores how clean data, automation and connected tools can improve the way work gets done. It's not about replacing people, it's about giving you time to use your skills and experience to provide the best services, build relationships and drive growth. Grounded in practical tips you can apply today, you'll leave understanding how the right technology supports your practice.

title: How to create massive impact and communicate like a zookeeper
description: Find out what being present means Who are you modelling from Do you have the right team Is your communication working

title: 999: How do we perform better under pressure
description: High-pressure situations are unavoidable, but performing well under pressure is a skill anyone can learn. In this keynote, former frontline Police Officer Rob Hosking shares lessons from environments where pressure was constant and mistakes carried real consequences. Through gripping real-world stories and practical tools, Rob explores how pressure impacts thinking, focus, and judgement, and how to stay calm, make better decisions, and perform consistently when demands are high. Delegates will leave with clear, usable techniques to manage pressure and sustain high performance in demanding roles.

title: AI, Tech and Transformation of the Practice Areas
categories: Market Overview & Insight, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, Data & Analytics, Practice Management
description: Artificial intelligence is not just changing the profession — it is redefining it. As firms move beyond automation to intelligence-driven operations, new opportunities are emerging to elevate client service, expand advisory capabilities and reimagine how work gets done. Drawing on insights from U.S. accounting firms, Erik Asgeirsson, president and CEO of CPA.com, will share how leading firms are harnessing AI and innovative business strategies to drive transformation, unlock growth and build future-ready practices in an increasingly dynamic and competitive environment.

title: An update from HMRC
description: In this session, HMRC will address important updates for the profession.

title: AI for bookkeepers: Simple steps to make AI your own assistant
description: AI isn't here to steal your job, it's here to take the boring bits off your plate. This talk cuts through the hype and fear to show bookkeepers how AI can become a practical, everyday assistant in their business. No tech wizardry required. I'll explore simple, real-world ways to use AI to save time, improve accuracy, streamline client communication, and support better decision-making, all without compromising compliance, ethics, or your professional judgment. Think of AI as the junior team member who never gets tired and works 24/7. You'll leave with clear, actionable steps to start using AI confidently and safely.

title: Bookkeepers mean business: Regulation, AI and the power of specialisation
description: Bookkeeping is no longer just about keeping books. It is about keeping business on track and becoming the human API behind the economy. In this strategic update, ICB CEO Ami Copeland shares regulatory insight, AI developments and key findings from ICB's 2026 State of the Profession research, outlining where the landscape is shifting and where opportunity lies. You will hear the latest on agent and ACSP registration, the MLRs, what AI can and cannot replace, and how ICB's new modular pathways give bookkeepers greater choice, flexibility and control over their careers.

title: Building a connected firm: Moving from fragmented tools to end-to-end workflows
categories: Bookkeeping, CRM & Comms, Expenses, Banking & Payments, Practice Management, eSign
description: Clients expect bookkeeping, spend management and payments to work together — yet most firms still operate with disconnected systems. This session unpacks how practices are redesigning their internal processes to create smoother, faster, more predictable client workflows. From unified data entry to clearer approval paths and cleaner handovers, learn how connected operations improve margins, reduce stress, and create a more modern client experience.

title: Growing through adversity to achieve your success
description: In October 2023, while dining with ICB colleagues in London, Paula choked on a piece of steak and was clinically dead for more than fifteen minutes. Thanks to the swift intervention of the restaurant manager and the rapid response of the emergency services, her life was saved. Her recovery, both physical and emotional, took many months. During this time, she took the opportunity to re-evaluate and rebuild both personally and professionally, a process that has had a profound impact on her lifestyle and the way she approaches her practice. Sharing this journey will no doubt inspire and encourage others to push forward with their goals.

title: How previous failures help me stop others failing
description: In the last 26 years I've failed a few times. Whether it's over-reaching, not keeping an eye on the bottom line, or just bad planning, I've experienced one disastrous failure and a few small ones too. Now I use that experience as well as that of those around me to help keep other business owners on the right path, so they can not only avoid the mistakes I made, but recognise when something is about to go horribly wrong and intervene before it does.

title: A no-nonsense marketing masterclass for accountants & bookkeepers
categories: Sales & Marketing / Branding / Social Media, Marketing & Growth, Practice Management
description: Marketing is part of running accounting or bookkeeping practice, even if it wasn't why you joined the profession. For many firms it sits between "I know it matters" and "I'll get to it when things are quieter". This interactive masterclass, led by marketers Callum Macrae and Elizabeth Carter (40+ years combined experience), focuses on what actually works for practices like yours. Whether you are just getting started, refining your approach, or simply want marketing to feel a bit less painful, this session will leave you with ideas you can actually use and a clearer sense of what is worth your effort.

title: The curious bookkeeper: Building a connected client centric practice
categories: Practice Management / Progressive Practice, AI & Automation, HR & People
description: In an increasingly automated world, you & your clients feel increasingly isolated. You set up your Practice to make a difference, yet you spend your day staring at a screen, wondering if technology is making you obsolete. You miss interacting with people and making a real difference in clients' businesses. Becoming a Curious Bookkeeper changes this. Discover the Applied Curiosity Model, a practical framework to unlock your curiosity, develop services, build great relationships, & boost your confidence. Practical tips you can apply immediately. The result? A future-proofed practice that works for you & your clients.

title: The power of networking: Turning connections into opportunities
description: In this interactive panel session, Gill Russel questions Lisa Pirie and Stephanie Nicolson on why they founded the network, Kent Kinnections, and how networking has been pivotal in growing their successful bookkeeping practices. Together, they explore how accountants and bookkeepers can build confidence, form meaningful relationships and unlock real opportunities through networking. Attendees will gain practical networking tips and see how a strong, diverse network becomes a trusted peer group of experts across IT, HR, marketing and social media - helping them feel supported and confident in their business.

speakers.name: Stephanie Nicolson
speakers.company: Books & Balance Ltd and Kent Kinnections Ltd

speakers.name: Lisa Pirie
speakers.company: Acey Bookkeeping Ltd and Kent Kinnections Ltd

title: The change-ready leader: Preparing your firm for what's next
categories: Motivation / Leadership / Mindset, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, HR & People, Practice Management
description: MTD forced change on you. AI, talent wars, and new regulations are already queuing up next. This session shows exhausted firm owners how to build firms that absorb disruption instead of breaking under it. You'll gain the: - Post-MTD triage system: which clients to save, which systems to repair first - "buffer" formula: calculating the time, money and headspace that protect you from the next crisis - Anti-fragile framework: three systems that turn regulatory chaos and future change into competitive advantage Walk away with the recovery roadmap AND the change-capacity audit that future-proof your practice.

title: Unlocking the power of self leadership
description: This session will explore the critical role of self leadership in a rapidly evolving professional landscape. In this session we will explore key themes such as self awareness, accountability, resilience, and mindset. The panel will share reflections from their own experiences, offering insights into the different approaches and mindsets that can help individuals navigate change, grow with confidence, shape their own development, and contribute meaningfully to their organisation or business.

speakers.name: Craig Dyer
speakers.company: C A Dyer Accounts & Bookkeeping Ltd

title: Break the narrative: Confident communication in finance & accountancy
description: In a profession defined by deadlines, scrutiny and high-pressure decision-making, the biggest challenges often come from the internal narratives we carry. This session helps finance & accountancy professionals break unhelpful stories, communicate with confidence & navigate difficult conversations with clarity. Blending lived experience with practical tools, Nick explores how mindset, language & self-awareness influence performance, resilience & leadership. Attendees will leave with simple, actionable strategies to express themselves, handle pressure & build stronger relationships in business & with themselves.

title: Mentorship vs. management: How to be the boss your trainees don't want to leave
description: In a competitive 2026 talent market, losing a trainee is a massive financial and cultural drain. This session challenges the traditional "manager" mindset, showing why checking work isn't the same as building a career. We explore how to bridge the gap between exam theory and office reality, transforming junior staff into loyal, strategic assets. This will be a trainer's-eye view of what Gen Z actually values, and an opportunity to share practical, low-cost mentoring frameworks that reduce burnout and ensure your trainees stay long after they qualify.

title: The architecture of leadership: How great leaders are actually built
categories: Motivation / Leadership / Mindset, Tax & MTD, HR & People
description: Leadership isn't something you inherit or earn through promotion – it's something that is deliberately built. In a finance sector facing rapid change, technical expertise alone is no longer enough. This session uses the metaphor of architecture to explore what really goes into building strong, effective leaders: solid foundations, clear structures, and the courage to renovate outdated habits. Delegates will leave with a practical framework for developing leadership capability that supports performance, people, and long-term resilience.

title: Why today's leaders need to connect and shape a better world
categories: Motivation / Leadership / Mindset, Data & Analytics, HR & People
description: Ever feel like there are too many tabs open in your web browser? Want to think big but struggle to carve out the headspace? Come and join this inter-active discussion based around this year's Sustainability Zone concept, "The Canopy" - a space to connect and shape a better world. What kind of future do you wish to see? We're inviting you to discover, play and dream about this future as Accountants and Bookkeepers. Meet like-minded people, share stories, contribute to the collective storytelling visualisation evolving under the giant tree. Come with questions, insights, ideas. Leave with more energy than you came with.

title: What got you here, might not get you there
description: Day 3 of the Marathon des Sables, 85km at 52°C, Ben nearly quit. His launch strategy was destroying him. Same happens to leaders: 80% fail within 18 months. Ben reveals the "Paradox of Progress". The fuel that launches you becomes toxic. Using his three-phase framework (Furious Founder, Stretched Operator, Accelerating Architect), audiences discover why leader fuel has a dangerous half-life, the one coaching question that transforms delegation, and the "run 10, walk 1" principle separating sustainable builders from burnout casualties. Expect adventure, hard data, and the strategic pause that changes everything.

title: The weight of leadership: Creating clarity, capacity and calm in accountancy practices
categories: Motivation / Leadership / Mindset, Data & Analytics, HR & People, Practice Management
description: Leadership in an accountancy practice often comes with an unspoken weight, being the decision-maker, the emotional anchor, and the one everyone turns to under pressure. Over time, this can quietly shape focus, wellbeing and team dynamics. This session explores the human side of leadership and how everyday habits, assumptions and responses influence clarity, capacity and culture. Using the Balanced Business Framework, attendees will gain insight into how to lead in a way that reduces strain, strengthens teams and creates a more sustainable working rhythm.

title: Why commercial thinking (not more clients) drives profit
description: Most accounting firms don't struggle because of a lack of clients they struggle because commercial thinking hasn't evolved alongside growth. Why Commercial Thinking (Not More Clients) Drives Profit challenges the belief that being busy equals being profitable. This session explores how commercial leadership influences pricing, client boundaries and service design. Drawing on real-world experience, attendees will gain practical insight into pricing with confidence, improving profitability and building a sustainable firm without increasing workload.

title: From automation to autonomy: Avoiding the AI-gym membership
description: Artificial intelligence in audit is often discussed in terms of automation, streamlining tasks, accelerating workflows, and increasing efficiency. But the next frontier is "agentic AI," where systems move beyond automation into autonomous problem-solving, scenario analysis, and decision support. For Audit leaders, the most effective path to adoption isn't an all-or-nothing leap; it starts with applying AI to smaller, well-defined parts of the audit process. This session will explore how agentic AI could transform Audit practices over time.

title: How I built my personal brand to over 80k followers and 20 million views with £0 budget
categories: How To Influence Up / How To Sell Yourself, Marketing & Growth
description: Growing a personal brand doesn't require money, it requires clarity, courage, and consistency. In this session, I'll share how I built an audience of over 80k followers and reached 20 million views from scratch with £0. I'll unpack the lessons, setbacks, and mindset shifts that made the difference, and show you what's possible when you start showing up strategically and authentically.

speakers.name: James Wright
speakers.job_title: Programme Leader of Accountancy & Finance and Senior Lecturer

title: Sales mastery: What the top 1% do differently
description: Sales Mastery: What the Top 1% Do Differently reveals how top-performing professionals and advisory teams consistently attract, win, and retain ideal clients without relying on outdated tactics. Attendees will learn the core habits, mindset shifts, and proven sales fundamentals elite professionals use to create trust, lead value-based conversations, and position their firm as the clear choice. The result is greater focus, confidence, and a repeatable approach to business development that drives predictable, sustainable growth.

title: LinkedIn for accountants & bookkeepers who hate showing off
categories: Sales & Marketing / Branding / Social Media, Marketing & Growth
description: Most accountants and bookkeepers don't need another "how to" on LinkedIn. They need a way to show up that doesn't feel cringey, salesy or unsafe. In this honest, story-led session, LinkedIn coach and former chef Ashley Leeds shares how a very normal bloke with a mortgage and a wobbly CV has used simple 15-minute-a-day habits to build a thriving business working with accountants and bookkeepers. You'll leave with an easy LinkedIn routine you can actually stick to, even if you hate being in the spotlight.

title: Balanced minds for busy accountants
description: Drawing on science, psychology and lived experience as an Accountant and Mindfulness teacher, Heather explores how mindfulness can reduce stress, improve concentration and build resilience in the accounting profession. The session includes a simple, practical technique to calm the nervous system and refocus during a busy day, and explains how mindfulness supports clarity under pressure. Attendees will leave with a clear understanding of why mindfulness works and practical tools they can use immediately to support focus, decision-making and wellbeing.

title: The advice is right: The gameshow for attracting, serving & retaining clients
categories: Sales & Marketing / Branding / Social Media, CRM & Comms, Data & Analytics, Marketing & Growth
description: This fun, engaging session offers current market insights, actionable tips and best practices for attracting, serving & retaining clients, delivered in a Gameshow format, with the chance to win real prizes. Your expertise, positioned correctly and communicated well, is the key to attracting your right fit clients and serving them at the highest level. You will learn how to differentiate yourself from every other firm offering similar services, how to avoid sounding robotic in your marketing and how to avoid common service complaints that break down client relationships. This one of a kind session is not to be missed!

title: Numbers tell, stories sell: Impactful communication for finance leaders
description: In a sector being reshaped by automation and GenAI, Ian Hawkins teaches finance leaders how to bridge the gap between technical expertise and non-technical stakeholders. This high-energy masterclass covers Ian's "Three Golden Principles" of influential communication, explains how storytelling works and how it can be used to boost engagement, overcome resistance and inspire transformation.

title: HMRC e-invoicing
description: HMRC talks e-invoicing: What is it? Who will need to do it? What happens next? As announced in the Autumn Statement 2025, e-invoicing will shortly become mandatory for small businesses. Hear from Jen Staves, Programme Director for E-invoicing at HMRC about what the change means for businesses, agents, and software suppliers. Find out what the next steps are, and opportunities for you to feed into the rollout of this policy.

title: Real-time visibility and control in the age of MTD and AI
categories: Practice Management / Progressive Practice, Tax & MTD, AI & Automation, Data & Analytics
description: As Making Tax Digital accelerates the shift to continuous reporting and AI reshaping the market, firms must move beyond disconnected tools and periodic compliance. This session will explore how progressive firms are redesigning their operating models to gain real-time visibility, stronger control and a competitive advantage.

title: Lessons accountants can learn from elite sport
description: The one-hour stage presentation, delivered by Steve and Roger, explores the non-negotiable traits of high performance in sport. Drawing on their own journeys, they reveal how these principles were forged through personal experience and how they translate directly into the mindset and behaviours required for success within any organisation. Through powerful storytelling, Steve and Roger share the highs of success and the lessons learned from the challenges they faced along the way. Each story connects back to a simple idea: how individuals in the room can develop the mindset, resilience and habits needed to perform at their best.

title: How soft skills shape confident communicators
description: Communication is the glue that holds every relationship together in business, on teams, and in life. It's not just what you say, it's how you say it. Whether you're sharing technical updates or navigating personal conversations, your ability to communicate with clarity, presence, and confidence shapes how others experience you. In this talk, Robyn Riedlinger breaks down the essential soft skills that every future speaker and leader must develop from active listening and emotional awareness to presence, tone, and message delivery. This is the foundation of leadership and the first step toward commanding any room, whether you're in a team huddle or on center stage.

title: Current tax issues for small businesses and their owners
description: This session will update you on recent tax changes including announcements about future changes that will affect your clients.

speakers.name: Rebecca Benneyworth
speakers.company: Rebecca Benneyworth and Co, Chartered Accountants

title: Rebecca and Paul Talking Tax
description: Rebecca Benneyworth MBE and Paul Aplin OBE take a look at some of the key tax administration and tax technology changes coming down the track in 2026 and beyond.

speakers.company: Rebecca Benneyworth and Co, Chartered Accountants

title: How to make your team happier and perform better – a practical guide to team wellbeing
description: We all know that a happy team is a better team. They perform better, stay together longer and even make more profit, but how do you make a team feel happier? In this interactive session, workplace wellbeing expert Richard Clarke will explain the real drivers of workplace wellbeing and share a practical framework you can follow to help your team feel a little happier at work. In this session you will learn: The five pillars of workplace wellbeing The steps required to implement a financially sound, scalable wellbeing strategy Why the staff at the Ritz Carlton in Central Park and Timpsons in the UK are some of the happiest employees around

title: Networking in Action
categories: Sales & Marketing / Branding / Social Media, Marketing & Growth
description: This high energy bootcamp will redefine how accounting professionals build meaningful relationships. Participants will explore practical frameworks to move beyond transactional networking and create trust-led, value-driven connections that support long-term growth, collaboration, and real impact.

description: Starting a firm with no clients, no network and no built-in pipeline is daunting, but it's absolutely possible. After attending Accountex 2024, I launched an accountancy firm from scratch, and then grew it to 100 clients in just over a year. In this session you'll learn the practical steps I wish I'd known from day one, how to decide your firm identity, common pitfalls (so you can avoid them) and practical steps for attracting high quality, aligned clients. Topics include: • Why positive communication matters • How and where you can communicate positively • Understanding the right marketing channels for the right message • Behaviours that create positive interactions • How to effectively implement into your firm

title: How to build resilience and thrive through challenges
categories: Mental Health & Wellbeing, Data & Analytics, HR & People
description: This is a practical, reflective session for those working in high-pressure, environments. Participants gain an understanding of how stress impacts thinking, emotions, energy and behavior & how resilience directly supports focus, confidence and sustainable success. The session combines insight, real-world examples & practical tools, guiding participants from understanding pressure to identifying what drains resilience & building strategies that support performance and wellbeing. It covers cognitive, emotional and social resilience, with a strong focus on self-talk, emotional regulation, boundaries and support.

title: Spreadsheets to stories: How to present with confidence and impact to non-finance stakeholders
categories: How To Influence Up / How To Sell Yourself
description: Numbers tell us what. Stories tell us why. Whether you are speaking to the board, communicating with internal teams, or addressing a room full of shareholders, the ability to present with confidence and clarity is a critical skill that all finance professionals must master in the modern workplace. In this interactive session, you will learn how to translate even the most complex financial data into a clear and compelling narrative and then deliver your message about those figures in a way that resonates with your stakeholders and helps them make better decisions (even if they don't usually understand numbers).

title: A Fireside Chat – The CFO Mandate of the Frontier Firm
description: Drawing on real-world experience, this fireside conversation explores how the CFO's role is evolving in organisations operating at the frontier of AI-enabled enterprise. As intelligent systems become embedded across marketing, sales, and operational decision-making, finance is playing a central role in shaping how resources are allocated, how performance is measured, and how value is created.

title: ERP Transformation: What finance leaders wish they had known
description: Most ERP projects fail. Not spectacularly - just slowly, expensively, and painfully. In this unmissable session, finance leaders who have been through the trenches share the hard-won lessons that rarely make it into the brochures, the boardroom presentations, or the post-implementation reviews. The pitfalls, the politics, the moments where it nearly all fell apart - and how they navigated them. If you're considering an ERP transformation, already in one, or trying to salvage one, this is the most important session you'll attend at The FD Show.

title: Agentic AI for Finance – AI that executes tasks, not just answers
description: What if your finance team had a tireless assistant that could process invoices, flag duplicates, route approvals, and reconcile transactions—24/7, with zero errors? That's agentic AI. Unlike chatbots that simply answer questions, agentic AI takes action: executing workflows, making decisions, and handling repetitive tasks so your team can focus on strategic priorities. Discover what's possible when AI moves from advisory to execution in the finance function.
